purpose: Reviewed exceptions for the currency-literal check (owner decision E3). Every entry needs a rationale and is reviewed like code.
rules: Entry forms: {"path": <repository-relative file>, "reason": ...} excludes one whole file; {"path": ..., "token": <code>, "reason": ...} allows one code in one file. Paths are exact; no globs.

entries.reason: The check's own reference list; it necessarily contains every code.
The allowlist itself names the allowed codes.
Vulnerability identifiers (CVE-...) are not currency literals; the Cape Verde escudo code only collides with the prefix.
